prompts.bookcase: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated transparent 2D side-scrolling game scenery sprite. Reference image is the exact style/material/design guide. Match the cutscene's handcrafted detailed retro pixel art, crisp square pixel clusters, near-black brown outlines, aged dark walnut, restrained warm amber edge wear and very subtle blue shadow accents. Front elevation, minimal depth, complete silhouette visible, small transparent margins, true alpha background. No room, wall, floor, cast shadow, child, text, labels, watermark, or extra separate objects. Not photorealism, no vector art. Recreate the tall dark Victorian bookcase filled with VHS tapes seen behind and left of the TV in the reference. A substantial carved walnut standing bookcase, slightly wider than a narrow cabinet, overall width-to-height ratio about 0.72. Four shelf compartments filled with uneven rows of old VHS cassette cases and a few books: mostly charcoal, desaturated navy, muted burgundy and faded cream spines, tiny blank label rectangles, several tilted cases and a couple of horizontal stacks. A modest carved cornice top, slim fluted side posts, thick shelves, low carved plinth and short feet. Worn antique details like the cutscene bookcase, not a flat modern shelving unit. No pots or decorations on top. Pixel detail about 96x128 logical pixels. Entire bookcase only.
